label: kedi: run $ZED_FILENAME
args: home=$KEDI_HOME; [ -n "$home" ] || home=$HOME/.kedi; if command -v kedi >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec kedi "$@"; fi; exec "$home/editor-venv/bin/python" -I -m kedi "$@"

label: kedi: test $ZED_FILENAME

label: kedi: eval $ZED_FILENAME
args: home=$KEDI_HOME; [ -n "$home" ] || home=$HOME/.kedi; if command -v kedi >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec kedi "$@"; fi; exec "$home/editor-venv/bin/python" -I -m kedi "$@"

label: kedi: run $ZED_FILENAME (Windows)
args: $kediHome = $env:KEDI_HOME; if (-not $kediHome) { $kediHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.kedi' }; if (Get-Command kedi -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & kedi $args } else { & (Join-Path $kediHome 'editor-venv\Scripts\python.exe') -I -m kedi $args }
